  {"step": 3, "file": "src/apps/fuzzers/fuzzerLocalIj.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 67, "var": "out", "code": "H3Error err = H3_EXPORT(localIjToCell)(args->index, &ij, 0, &out);", "note": "localIjToCell is invoked with the attacker-controlled origin index and ij coordinates."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/h3lib/lib/localij.c", "function": "H3_EXPORT(localIjToCell)", "line": 566, "var": "ijk", "code": "ijToIjk(ij, &ijk);", "note": "ijToIjk sets ijk=(i,j,0) and calls _ijkNormalize; integer overflow in _ijkNormalize leaves ijk=(-14671840,-2147483648,0)."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/h3lib/lib/coordijk.c", "function": "_ijkNormalize", "line": 210, "var": "c->i, c->j, c->k", "code": "c->i -= c->k; c->j -= c->k;", "note": "32-bit signed overflow during normalization wraps values back to (-14671840,-2147483648,0), a non-unit vector with all components <= 1."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/h3lib/lib/localij.c", "function": "localIjkToCell", "line": 320, "var": "ijk", "code": "if (ijk->i > 1 || ijk->j > 1 || ijk->k > 1) { return E_FAILED; }", "note": "Bounds check passes because all components are <= 1, so execution continues despite ijk not being a valid unit vector."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src/h3lib/lib/localij.c", "function": "localIjkToCell", "line": 325, "var": "dir", "code": "const Direction dir = _unitIjkToDigit(ijk);", "note": "_unitIjkToDigit normalizes ijk again and finds no matching unit vector, returning INVALID_DIGIT (7)."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "src/h3lib/lib/localij.c", "function": "localIjkToCell", "line": 326, "var": "newBaseCell", "code": "const int newBaseCell = _getBaseCellNeighbor(originBaseCell, dir);", "note": "_getBaseCellNeighbor indexes baseCellNeighbors[121][7] with dir=7, reading 4 bytes past the 7-element row -> global-buffer-overflow READ 4."}
]
EOF

- `LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput` at `fuzzerLocalIj.c:58`
